feature: Monthly workout calendar with manual Google draft and ICS export
google_open_in_browser_suite: Mocked; URL and disclosure validated, no real Google write
runner: Local browser runner against the public HTTPS site; not hosted CI
limits: Manual Google drafts and ICS snapshots; no automatic or two-way sync
All-day events; workout start times are not stored
Only planned workouts in the displayed month are exported
Exercise details are excluded from external event data
Re-imports may duplicate events; later journal edits do not update external copies
